Title: It's time to remove "Become Anarch" action from the rulebook.

Messages.Author: AaronC
Messages.Body:
"Anarch" is no longer a trait: it is a Sect.

Whole clans of vampires have been and will continue to be printed with the Anarch Sect.

There is no cardless action to become a member of other Sects.

The Anarch Sect is arguably the best Sect in the game. Its non-titled member gain access to a large range of cards that are superior to the cards available to non-titled members of other Sects in terms of quantity and quality, particularly combat cards.

For instance, the only cards that non-Camarilla vampires can play based on their Sect are political actions, almost all of which grant titles. Meanwhile, the Anarch Sect grants its non-titled members access to 76 cards, not counting Fee Stakes.

With those kinds of options, it's no wonder that we so many non-titled vampires becoming Anarch.

The Anarch Sect doesn't need help anymore. There is no more reason to have a "Become Anarch" cardless action in the rulebook, so it should be removed.

Second. If this change is aimed at reducing the help for anarch sect, why does it boost the effectiveness of Anarch Revolt against multitude of decks without anarchs or anarch converts by preventing them from gaining immunity against player placing one Anarch Revolt down every turn...

Name: Anarch Revolt [Jyhad:U, VTES:U, CE:U, Anarchs:PAB2, KMW:PAn, Third:U, V5C:PTz1] Cardtype: Master Put this card in play. A Methuselah not controlling a ready Anarch burns 1 pool during their unlock phase. Vampires can call a referendum to burn this card as a +1 stealth political action. Artist: Pete Venters; Steve Prescott

Due to Anarch Revolt's changed current existence, I disagree with this suggestion. I'm not even sure if return to the Jyhad era text with Anarch Revolt is enough to change that disagreement to neutral, after all we lose Infamous Insurgent Enkidu...
